name: pavurel-design
description: Review and improve Pavurel websites and Conference Manager Customer and Platform interfaces under their current repository standards, with optional requested 21st design research.

interface.longDescription: Apply the existing Pavurel website or Customer and Platform design profile while keeping current target-repository requirements authoritative. Includes three reviewed skills and their supporting references. Use 21st research only when requested and when the separate connection is actually available.
defaultPrompt: Use pavurel-web-design to review the German and English website pages for repeated content and demo CTA placement without editing.
Use pavurel-app-design to review a Customer or Platform workflow against its current repository standards without editing.
Use 21st-design-research to search for relevant component references and return up to three source names and IDs; do not retrieve code or generate anything.
